subject.title: [Bug]: Ctrl+C not working in Windows install on foreground

question: Should this issue stay in manual-review until native Windows npm-global Ctrl+C reproduction is captured before queueing a repair PR?
rationale: Current source handles delivered SIGINT, but the failing Windows Ctrl+C delivery path is not proven on current main and the only linked fix PR was closed unmerged as an unsafe mixed-scope branch.

options.title: Require Windows live repro
options.body: Keep this open for a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter to validate current main or the latest package in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

options.title: Queue after signal-delivery proof
options.body: If live proof confirms Ctrl+C is not delivered to the foreground gateway process, queue a narrow run-loop or wrapper fix with cleanup tests and Windows package proof.

options.title: Close only if current main works
options.body: If native Windows npm-global testing shows current main and the latest release now shut down cleanly, close this as not reproducible with that proof.

recommendation.title: Require Windows live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this open for a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter to validate current main or the latest package in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest longer-term history for gateway foreground lifecycle and restart handling points to this area contributor.
